defs.def: attracting your attention because it is special, exciting or unusual 有趣的；有吸引力的adv.

ex.s: This time they found the exercise much more interesting.
ex.t: 那个男人僵了一秒，但当他看到这个瘦弱的男孩时松了一口气。

ex.s: Before choosing to study online, consider whether you’re a self-motivated learner and if the material seems interesting enough to keep you going.
ex.t: 在选择在线学习之前，要考虑自己是否是一个有自学动力的人，以及学习材料是否足够有趣能让你坚持下去。

ex.s: Movement in art has an interesting role.
ex.t: 艺术中的运动扮演着有趣的角色。

ex.s: It's a technique that helps turn a long narrative into an interesting one.
ex.t: 这是一种把冗长叙述变成有趣故事的技巧。

ex.s: According to Jessica Hagy, author of How to Be Interesting, it's not difficult to make yourself interesting at a dinner party.
ex.t: 据《如何变得有趣》一书的作者杰西卡·哈吉所说，在晚宴上让自己变得有趣并不难。

ex.s: So being interesting at a dinner party isn’t that hard.
ex.t: 所以在晚宴上变得有趣并没有那么难。

ex.s: "There is a lot of really interesting evidence which seems to be suggesting that if children are inspired up to the age of seven, then being outdoors will be a habit for life." His own children have got into the habit of playing outside now: "We just send them out into the garden and tell them not to come back in for a while."
ex.t: “有大量非常有趣的证据似乎表明，如果孩子在七岁前受到启发，那么待在户外将成为一生的习惯。”他自己的孩子现在也养成了在外面玩的习惯：“我们只是把他们赶到花园里，告诉他们一会儿别回来。”

ex.s: These specialists could work at the office until ten each night, then look back and realize they would have loved to have gone home and enjoyed the sweetness of their family and friends, or traveled to exciting places, meeting interesting people.
ex.t: 这些专家可能在办公室工作到每天晚上十点然后回头看才发现他们本可以早点回家享受家人朋友的甜蜜或者去激动人心的地方旅行结识有趣的人。

ex.s: Interestingly，the more cheerful the music was，the faster their heart rates were．
ex.t: 有趣的是音乐越欢快他们的心率越快。

ex.s: People want to listen to someone who is interesting, relaxed and comfortable.
ex.t: 人们想听有趣、放松、自在的人讲话。

ex.s: Making small talk interesting.
ex.t: 让闲聊变得有趣。

ex.s: Making small talk interesting.
ex.t: 让闲聊变得有趣。

ex.s: Making small talk interesting.
ex.t: 让闲聊变得有趣。

ex.s: They have transformed themselves into places where you can develop your love of knowledge meet interesting people, or find out how to start a business.
ex.t: 它们已经把自己转变成了这样的地方：你可以在这里培养对知识的热爱、结识有趣的人，或者了解如何创业。

ex.s: I became interesting in playing football thanks to a small accident.
ex.t: 多亏一次小意外，我对踢足球产生了兴趣。

ex.s: Uniforms can be useful in unexpected ways, A school in Ireland has introduced an interesting new uniform.
ex.t: 校服可能在意想不到的方面有用，爱尔兰一所学校推出了一款有趣的新校服。

ex.s: Interestingly，this trend isn’t evident in baseball. where additional individual talent keeps improving the team’s performance.
ex.t: 有趣的是，这种趋势在棒球中并不明显，因为在棒球里增加个人天赋会持续提升团队表现。

ex.s: Knowledgeable guides will entertain you with the most, interesting stories about Presidents, Congress, memorials, and parks.
ex.t: 知识渊博的导游会用关于总统、国会、纪念碑和公园最有趣的故事逗你开心。

ex.s: Enjoy interesting stories.
ex.t: 喜欢有趣的故事。

ex.s: What is even more interesting is that one of Stein's jobs is defending an industry behind the plastic shopping bags.
ex.t: 更有趣的是，斯坦的工作之一是为塑料购物袋背后的产业辩护。

ex.s: One of the interesting ways the study of economics relates to human behavior generally is that a lot of economic theory is the formalization of the kind of simple concept outlined above — a consumer's informal understanding of the amount she has to spend and what that amount will buy.
ex.t: 经济学研究与一般人类行为相关的一个有趣之处是，许多经济理论是对上述简单概念——消费者对可花费金额及该金额能买到什么的非正式理解——的形式化。

ex.s: Keep interesting magazine pictures to give children story ideas.
ex.t: 保留有趣的杂志图片，给孩子们提供故事创意。

ex.s: It took three years to complete and was built using an interesting method.
ex.t: 它花了三年时间才建成，并采用了一种有趣的建造方法。

ex.s: In their spare time, they are interesting in planting vegetables in their garden, that is on the rooftop of their house.
ex.t: 在业余时间，他们对在花园里种菜很感兴趣，花园就在他们房子的屋顶上。

ex.s: This isn’t as hard as it    62   (sound), and it is far better than any other method because you improve your vocabulary while    63   (read) an interesting piece of literature.
ex.t: 这并不像它___62___（听起来）那么难，而且远比任何其他方法好，因为你在___63___（阅读）一篇有趣的文学作品时提高了词汇量。

ex.s: I had an interesting childhood.
ex.t: 我有一个有趣的童年。

ex.s: It took three years to complete and was built using an interesting method.
ex.t: 它花了三年时间才建成，并采用了一种有趣的建造方法。

ex.s: In their spare time, they are interesting in planting vegetables in their garden, that is on the rooftop of their house.
ex.t: 在业余时间，他们对在花园里种菜很感兴趣，花园就在他们房子的屋顶上。

ex.s: We figured that in twenty years each of us ought to have our destiny worked out and our fortunes made, whatever they were going to be.”“It sounds pretty interesting,” said the policeman.
ex.t: 我们想，二十年后，我们每个人都应该已经确定了自己的命运，并且发了财，不管结果会是什么。＂＂听起来挺有意思的，＂警察说。

ex.s: They have been to many interesting places.
ex.t: 他们去过许多有趣的地方。

ex.s: Interestingly, the letters did not contain the usual warnings to children that they might not receive their presents if the were not good.
ex.t: 有趣的是，这些信并没有包含通常对孩子们的警告，即如果表现不好可能就收不到礼物了。

ex.s: Movies of course need impressive images, so why has Alice in Wonderland only resulted in movies best described as “interesting”?
ex.t: 电影当然需要令人印象深刻的画面，所以为什么《爱丽丝梦游仙境》只产生了最好被描述为'有趣'的电影？

ex.s: Interestingly,audiences have in recent years turned to television series such as Sherlock or Mad Men, which can have many characters and gradual plot development.
ex.t: 有趣的是，近年来观众转向了像《神探夏洛克》或《广告狂人》这样的电视剧集，这些剧集可以有众多角色和渐进的剧情发展。
